phase_name: De-reference the routing and orchestration-engine documentation
notes: Repo-wide census after Phase 6: 84 occurrences across 30 files remaining (down from 201/41 post-Phase-4) -- entirely Phase 7's designated scope (contracts, patterns, standards, scripts, extension-side citations).

Surfaced a real architectural consequence while rewriting handoff-schema.md: core's general/meta/markdown task types now resolve hard-mode implement dispatch to the SAME base-mode general-implementation-agent (routing_agents_hard removed for core), which never writes .orchestrator-handoff.json -- so core task types under --hard no longer produce a handoff at all; only cslib and lean, which retain their own hard-mode implementation agents, remain active writers. Documented explicitly rather than silently glossed over.

check-extension-docs.sh re-run after this phase shows the same 7 expected 'deployed script content drift' FAILs as after Phase 4 (no new categories, no broken references) -- confirms this phase introduced no new deploy-consistency issues.
